all_checkpoints_summary.CP1_unc103: PASS (11/11 holds, div<0.001; bug found+fixed in NEURONReference)

headline_finding: Brian2 4-channel AVA cell [IRK + LEAK + EGL19 + NCA] reproduces Nicoletti's canonical NEURON AVAL phenotype to ~5 decimal places of V trajectory across all 7 published current-clamp sweeps (1000 ms protocol, -30 to +30 pA). Cleanest apples-to-apples Brian2-vs-NEURON agreement achieved in any Wave 2 phase to date.
prompt_corrections_documented: Original Wave 2 option α prompt's '5-channel AVAL with UNC-103' was an orchestrator-side error (conflated AVAR's channel list with AVAL's). Verified primary-source: AVAL has 4 channels, AVAR has 5.
Original Wave 2 option α prompt's 'F2 GLOBAL→per-cell pattern for UNC-103' was a misattribution. F2 is about caintra1's Ca trajectory; UNC-103's NMODL has no GLOBAL state.

Both errors caught by primary-source pre-flight pushback before code commit. Same propagation pattern as Mellem 2008 / Nicoletti 2019 PCBI / Wang 2001 / speculative per-cell table errors documented in architectural_plan_citation_audit.md.
files_modified: wave2/neuron_reference.py — added 'unc103' to custom-cell K-current recording list (one-line bug fix)
limitations_noted: 4-channel parameterization produces non-physiological V extremes at large injections (+120 mV at +30 pA, -175 mV at -30 pA). NEURON shows the same — this is a feature of Nicoletti's parameterization, not a translation defect.

Cell does NOT reproduce Mellem 2008 plateau dynamics. That phenotype requires SLO-1 + Ca-induced Ca release machinery not present in 4-channel AVAL. Phase F's 2b cell (7-channel) was the previous attempt to reproduce Mellem; it failed (Condition 6 surfaced). The α-1 cell is explicitly NOT trying to reproduce Mellem — it matches Nicoletti's own AVAL, which is a different (simpler) phenotype.
